source: DEMO DATA. Invented, not measured. Every name here is chosen to explain itself to an audience with no context. Nothing in this file describes a real fleet.

tools.name: which-machine
tools.one_liner: Says which computer you are on right now
tools.plain: tells you which computer you are actually on

tools.name: open-on-my-screen
tools.one_liner: Opens a page on whichever screen the person is sitting at
tools.plain: opens a page on the screen the person is actually sitting at

tools.name: hand-me-the-file
tools.one_liner: Copies a finished file onto the person's own computer
tools.plain: copies a finished file onto the person's own computer

tools.name: reach-the-others
tools.one_liner: Runs one command on every other machine at once
tools.plain: runs one command on every other machine at once

tools.name: who-is-awake
tools.one_liner: Lists which machines are switched on and reachable
tools.plain: lists which machines are switched on and reachable

tools.name: no-secrets-in-public
tools.one_liner: Refuses to publish anything containing a password or key
tools.plain: refuses to publish anything with a password in it

tools.name: ask-before-deleting
tools.one_liner: Stops a delete command and asks first
tools.plain: stops a delete command and asks first

tools.name: no-empty-claims
tools.one_liner: Blocks the words done and shipped when no proof is attached
tools.plain: blocks the word done when no proof is attached

tools.name: answer-every-point
tools.one_liner: Counts the points in a request and blocks a reply that skips one
tools.plain: blocks a reply that quietly skips part of the request

tools.name: plain-words-only
tools.one_liner: Flags jargon and undefined shorthand before it reaches a person
tools.plain: flags jargon before it reaches a person

tools.name: which-model
tools.one_liner: Reports which AI model this session is running on
tools.plain: reports which AI model is doing the work

tools.name: cheapest-lane
tools.one_liner: Sends routine lookups to the cheapest model that can do them
tools.plain: sends routine lookups to the cheapest model that can do them

tools.name: quota-left
tools.one_liner: Shows how much of each AI subscription is still unspent
tools.plain: shows how much of each subscription is still unspent

tools.name: write-one-row
tools.one_liner: Appends a single permanent row to a shared record
tools.plain: adds one permanent row to a shared record

tools.name: read-the-record
tools.one_liner: Reads back what a ledger already says before writing to it
tools.plain: reads back what a record already says before adding to it

tools.name: count-the-gaps
tools.one_liner: Counts promises with no matching entry
tools.plain: counts the promises with nothing recorded against them

tools.name: put-it-online
tools.one_liner: Publishes a page and checks it actually loads
tools.plain: publishes a page and checks it actually loads

tools.name: check-it-loaded
tools.one_liner: Opens the published page and compares it to the source
tools.plain: opens the published page and compares it to the source

tools.name: behind-the-door
tools.one_liner: Fetches a page that sits behind a login wall
tools.plain: fetches a page that sits behind a login wall

tools.name: free-the-memory
tools.one_liner: Clears memory when a machine starts running short
tools.plain: clears memory when a machine starts running short

tools.name: stuck-process
tools.one_liner: Finds and stops a process that has hung
tools.plain: finds and stops a program that has hung

tools.name: keep-it-awake
tools.one_liner: Stops a machine going to sleep mid-job
tools.plain: stops a machine going to sleep in the middle of a job

tools.name: disk-is-filling
tools.one_liner: Warns before a disk runs out of room
tools.plain: warns before a disk runs out of room

tools.name: read-the-whole-folder
tools.one_liner: Reads every file in a folder in one pass
tools.plain: reads every file in a folder in one pass

tools.name: screenshot-the-page
tools.one_liner: Loads a page in a real browser and captures what it looks like
tools.plain: loads a page in a real browser and photographs it

tools.name: draw-the-chart
tools.one_liner: Turns a table of numbers into a readable chart
tools.plain: turns a table of numbers into a readable chart

tools.name: spell-it-out
tools.one_liner: Rewrites a technical paragraph in plain words
tools.plain: rewrites a technical paragraph in plain words

tools.name: find-the-duplicate
tools.one_liner: Finds the same thing written twice in two places
tools.plain: finds the same thing written twice in two places

tools.name: name-the-file
tools.one_liner: Names a new file the way every other file is named
tools.plain: names a new file the way every other file is named

processes.name: Features Ledger
processes.one_liner: Every promise made about the product is written down the moment it is made
processes.plain: every promise made about the product is written down the moment it is made, so none of them can quietly disappear

satellite.name: Broken Promises
satellite.one_liner: Re-reads every promise in the ledger and names the ones the product never kept
satellite.plain: goes back through every promise in the ledger and names the ones the product never actually kept

processes.name: MemSearch
processes.one_liner: Searches everything the team has ever said, so nothing has to be remembered twice
processes.plain: searches everything the team has ever said, so nobody has to remember it twice

processes.name: Autosync
processes.one_liner: Keeps every machine's copy of the shared records in step, on a timer
processes.plain: keeps every machine's copy of the shared records in step, on its own timer — nothing done in a session can light it

processes.name: Troubleshooting Ledger
processes.one_liner: Every fault diagnosed is written down with the one check that settles it
processes.plain: every fault that gets diagnosed is written down, along with the single check that settles it next time

processes.name: Penta Review
processes.one_liner: Five rival AI models review the work together, or it does not ship
processes.plain: five rival AI models review the work together, and if one of them is missing the review does not run at all

processes.name: Second Opinion
processes.one_liner: A second, independent AI judges the proof before work counts as done
processes.plain: a second, independent AI judges the proof before any work counts as done

processes.name: Decision Page
processes.one_liner: Every real decision gets a clickable page, then a permanent written record
processes.plain: every real decision gets a page you click through, and then a permanent written record of what was chosen

processes.name: Escape Log
processes.one_liner: Shipped work later found broken is logged; the trend steers quality
processes.plain: anything shipped that later turns out broken gets logged, and the trend tells the team what to fix

processes.name: Publish Gate
processes.one_liner: Every public page goes out through one verified route
processes.plain: every public page goes out through one route that checks it actually loaded

processes.name: Work Routing
processes.one_liner: Routine lookup and mechanical work go to cheaper helper agents
processes.plain: routine lookups and mechanical edits go to cheaper helper agents, so the expensive one is kept for judgment

processes.name: Brand Gate
processes.one_liner: Blocks an invented logo or an off-template page before it ships
processes.plain: blocks an invented logo or an off-template page before it ever ships

workflows.name: first-draft
workflows.one_liner: Turns one sentence into a working first version
workflows.plain: turns one sentence into a working first version

workflows.name: full-check
workflows.one_liner: Runs every check and fixes what it finds, until nothing is left
workflows.plain: runs every check and fixes what it finds, over and over, until nothing is left

workflows.name: customer-walk
workflows.one_liner: Clicks through the product like a real customer and reports what it saw
workflows.plain: clicks through the product like a real customer and reports what it actually saw

workflows.name: design-pass
workflows.one_liner: Brings in the right design specialists for the job
workflows.plain: brings in the right design specialists for the job at hand

workflows.name: night-shift
workflows.one_liner: Works through the plan overnight without supervision
workflows.plain: works through the plan overnight without anyone watching, pausing and resuming itself

workflows.name: ask-around
workflows.one_liner: Puts the same question to several models and reports where they disagree
workflows.plain: puts the same question to several models at once and reports where they disagree

workflows.name: tidy-up
workflows.one_liner: Removes dead code and duplicate work left behind by earlier passes
workflows.plain: removes dead code and duplicated work left behind by earlier passes
